point.title: Interactive Canvas Runtime
point.rationale: CanvasWorkspace owns document-session lifetimes, while CanvasSession exposes separate reactive stores for document, presentation, selection, controls, and status. The tldraw adapter owns live geometry and native undo navigation, committing settled gestures through the domain controller. Shape projection and routing connect semantic diagrams to interactive rendering without persisting every pointer frame.
